summary: The PrfHomeContacts user control manages home contact details in a web application, featuring editing and display functionalities.
purpose: To handle the display and editing of home contact information within a web application, including integrating with user sessions and phone masking.

workflows.name: Edit and Save Home Contacts
steps: Switch to edit mode using cmdEdit button click.
Show details in modal using mdlDetails.
Check if ScreenIsEditable to display cmdSave button.
Remove phone mask if UserSession.UsePhoneMask is false.
Bind JavaScript variables conditionally based on async postback.

conditions: Check ScreenIsEditable to toggle visibility of cmdSave and cmdEdit buttons.
Cancel dsStaff_Selecting if UserSession is null.
Use UserSession.CountryCode if txtCountry.Text is empty.
system_behavior: Data binding to fvwEditHomeContacts and data source dsStaff.
JavaScript variable setup for client-side operations.
